subject.en: Left-facing chestnut lyrebird with a cream throat and a three-stem crown plume
subject.zh: 向左侧望的栗棕色琴鸟，奶油色喉部与三枝冠羽

description.en: The left-facing portrait and three-part crown keep their familiar arrangement. A small downward placement gives the complete plume room, while the lower neck continues through the frame.
description.zh: 保留向左侧望的头像与三枝冠羽的关系。整体轻轻下移，为完整冠羽留出余地，颈部仍然自然延伸到画面之外。

description.en: Connected chestnut, russet, and gold planes describe the head and crown. The cream throat opens the lower face, and the warm dark eye retains the original calm expression.
description.zh: 栗棕、赤褐与金色的连续切面构成头部和冠羽。奶油色喉部照亮脸的下方，温暖的深色眼睛延续原有安静的神情。

description.en: Open U-shaped string impressions fall through a terracotta paper field. Fine grain and shallow shadows connect this musical rhythm to the family’s matte presentation.
description.zh: 开放的 U 形琴弦压纹从陶土色纸面上垂落。细腻颗粒与浅阴影让这份音乐节奏融入家族统一的哑光质感。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px, the leftward beak, cream throat, and three-part crown remain distinct. At 16 px, the fine crown stems and eye highlights simplify into the warm bird silhouette.
sizeNote.zh: 在 32 px 下，向左的鸟喙、奶油色喉部与三枝冠羽仍能区分。缩到 16 px 时，细冠羽枝干和眼睛高光会合并进暖色鸟形。
